home.subtitle: Freelance fullstack developer based in Grenoble. I design and build custom websites and applications, built for your business and your users — from the first brief to production.

about.title: Here's a little about
about.description: I'm a freelance fullstack developer, based in Grenoble during my engineering apprenticeship at IMT Nord Europe. For over 4 years I've been building digital tools for research labs, independents and small businesses — from the first call to going live, never leaving a project half-finished. What matters to me isn't just that it works: it's that it's clean, fast, and that you can run it without me six months from now.
about.quote: I like projects where we end up being more than just client and freelancer.
